subject: [PATCH 2/4] btrfs: honor FMODE_NOCMTIME when punching holes

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch addresses an issue where Btrfs was updating the c/mtime of files even when FMODE_NOCMTIME was set, which can cause problems for NFS clients holding delegated timestamps. The patch introduces a new function btrfs_should_update_cmtime() to determine whether c/mtime should be updated based on file mode and flags. It then uses this function in btrfs_write_check() and replaces the update_times flag with an argument in btrfs_replace_file_extents(). Finally, it updates btrfs_punch_hole() to skip c/mtime updates for FMODE_NOCMTIME files. This patch fixes a regression introduced by a previous commit that froze c/mtime updates during WRITE_ATTRS delegation.
